macros.name: pydatabufferkey
macros.doc: Append a key to the buffer.

macros.name: pydatabufferkeyedefvalue
macros.doc: Append a key and a single-line value to the buffer simultaneously.

macros.name: pydatabufferkeyvalue
macros.doc: Append a key and a single-line value to the buffer simultaneously.

macros.name: pydatabuffermdfivesum
macros.doc: Calculate the MD5 hash of the current buffer, using \str_mdfive_hash:e.

macros.name: pydatabuffervalue
macros.doc: Append a single-line value to the buffer.

macros.name: pydataclearbuffername
macros.doc: Delete the specified buffer.

macros.name: pydataclearmeta
macros.doc: Clear all metadata.

macros.name: pydataclearschema
macros.doc: Delete existing schema.

macros.name: pydataclosefilename
macros.doc: Close a file previously opened with \pydatasetfilename.

macros.name: pydatareleasefilehandle
macros.doc: When the file handle is no longer in use, \pydatareleasefilehandle is recommended (but not required) to remove references to the file handle and perform basic checking for incomplete or malformed data written to file.

macros.name: pydatasetbuffername
macros.doc: Initialize a new buffer if 〈buffername 〉 has not been used previously, and configure all buffer operations to use 〈buffername 〉. 〈buffername 〉 is used as a base name for creating the buffer line macros of the form \〈buffername 〉line〈n 〉 and the buffer length macro \〈buffername 〉length.

macros.name: pydatasetfilehandle
macros.doc: Configure writing to file using an existing file handle created with \newwrite.

macros.name: pydatasetfilename
macros.doc: Configure a file for writing based on filename, opening the file if necessary.

macros.name: pydatasetschemakeytype
macros.doc: Define a key’s schema.

macros.name: pydatasetschemamissing
macros.doc: \pydatasetschemamissing Define behavior for missing key-value pairs in a schema.

macros.name: pydatawritedictclose
macros.doc: Write a closing dict delimiter } to file.

macros.name: pydatawritedictopen
macros.doc: Write an opening dict delimiter { to file.

macros.name: pydatawritekey
macros.doc: Write a key to file.

macros.name: pydatawritekeyedefvalue
macros.doc: Write a key and a single-line value to file simultaneously.

macros.name: pydatawritekeyvalue
macros.doc: Write a key and a single-line value to file simultaneously.

macros.name: pydatawritelistclose
macros.doc: Write a closing list delimiter ] to file.

macros.name: pydatawritelistopen
macros.doc: Write an opening list delimiter [ to file.

macros.name: pydatawritemeta
macros.doc: Write metadata, including schema, to a file previously configured with \pydatasetfilename or \pydatasetfilehandle.

macros.name: pydatawritevalue
macros.doc: Write a single-line value to file.
